issues.description: Field visibility mismatch for Farm.animals: the UML in problem_statement.md declares the attribute as private ('- animals: List<Animal>') and the textual instructions require providing a getter and a setter. In the reference solution (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java at line 9) the field is declared as public ('public List<Animal> animals;'), which contradicts the UML and the encapsulation intent described in the problem. This inconsistency may confuse students about whether the animals list should be a private attribute with accessor methods or a public field.
issues.suggestedFix: Make Farm.animals private in the solution to match the UML and the instructional text (change to 'private List<Animal> animals;') and keep the public getAnimals()/setAnimals() accessor methods. Update any external code to use the accessor methods rather than relying on direct public field access. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML if the intent is to teach using a public field (but prefer making the field private to teach encapsulation).
